Team dossier Operation Nothing To See Here

Area 51 Bureau

The truth is out there. So is the trash.

Team color
Green
Threat level
Classified, mostly by accident
Catnip & Hairball
3 hairballs · 1 catnip

Known for

  • Being outed by its own recycling (PNN-004).
  • A team name that promises secrets and a trash can that kept none.
  • Declining to comment, loudly.
  • Agents, a saucer, and a cow with a complaint.

The file

The Area 51 Bureau built its brand on secrecy: agents, a flying saucer, a cow in mid-abduction. A team like that is supposed to be impossible to catch. Then the Pyro Posse crowned two garbage cans with balloons and tissue-paper flames, and the Bureau's cover-up was blown by its own driveway.

PNN reminds the Bureau that Roswell was a long time ago and this was in front of the house. The cans were not abducted. They were accessorized. For a team that exists to bury the truth, there are now several balloons on it.

The Bureau has declined to comment. PNN considers this consistent with the file, which the Bureau has redacted several times on its own, to be safe. The redactions are the most informative part.

In fairness, the poster the Posse made of the Bureau looks like a movie, and 'A Dumpster Fire. Disaster.' is a title most teams would trade a witch for. The Bureau's only real vulnerability is the one thing it cannot classify: the curb.

Strengths

  • A genuinely good logo, with agents.
  • Total commitment to the bit. The bit is secrecy.
  • A flying saucer on call.

Weaknesses

  • Curbs.
  • Trash day.
  • Anything visible from space, including balloons.

Clueso's advice

Bring the bins in. Then deny you ever had bins.

— Inspector Clueso, PNN
